routeReason: The defect changes reward selection, terminal settlement, collision attribution and shared finish rendering across levels and mobile/desktop viewports.

acceptanceCriteria: Finish options form one contiguous wall with visible multiplier labels including ×0.5.
A knife contact with the wall settles the lane without allowing the knife to cross the wall plane.
Higher reward multipliers occupy narrower lanes than the ×0.5 recovery lane.
Existing settlement, replay and bonus behavior remain intact on desktop and mobile natural journeys.
decision: OPEN; proceed through formal fixer implementation and independent QA retest.
